save_parameters_checkpoint: save model parameters to an orbax checkpoint at the specified path
load_parameters_single_device: load parameters from an orbax checkpoint onto a single JAX device
load_parameters_replicated: load parameters from an orbax checkpoint replicated across all JAX devices
load_parameters_custom_sharding: load parameters from an orbax checkpoint with a user-specified pytree of jax sharding specs
save_and_load_checkpoint: save model parameters to a checkpoint and reload them with custom sharding configuration
